title: An out-of-stock row keeps its price and is read as a shop price the shop does not currently sell
comment: DEFECTS row D-267, sweep Family 2 A4: hammer.ts writes in_stock = 0 but still writes the price, and no reader looks at in_stock (6,976 priced rows). Planted as rows: a gtin-joined row for product 0000000000024 with in_stock = 0 and a price.
ifMissed: A rule on out-of-stock rows that still carry a price and are read by the estimate.
